category: machine translation API, legacy recurring free plan closed to new sign-ups

free_tier.stated: 500,000 characters per month for free on the DeepL API Free plan; the plan can no longer be purchased and has been replaced by the one-time 1,000,000 character Developer plan
free_tier.notes: the true unit is source characters per month; the schema vocabulary has no character unit, so mixed is the nearest term. The plan does not include DeepL Write or speech to text translation. Whether keys issued earlier still answer is unverified: it needs an existing account

per_object_cap.stated: 128 KiB total request size and 16 KiB header size; document limit column for free plans is 10 MB and 500,000 characters for a Word file

retention.stated: not applicable: a translation endpoint stores nothing for the caller

tooling: HTTP REST API at https://api-free.deepl.com with the header 'Authorization: DeepL-Auth-Key <key>'; keys of this plan end in ':fx'; up to 2 keys per Free API subscription
chaining: none for a new account: the plan is closed; the Developer plan (one-time 1,000,000 characters) is the current free entry

limits.value: 128 KiB total request size; 16 KiB header size
